items.title: Toolbox › Desktop: Smart App Suggestions — Your most used apps, learned from the files you open.
Toolbox › Desktop: Voice Search — Say what to search for (5 s, English, offline).
Toolbox › Desktop: Smart Window Arrangement — Puts every window on this desktop side by side.
Toolbox › Desktop: Activity History — Files you opened recently, newest first.
Toolbox › Desktop: Desktop Profiles — Save/load wallpaper, panel, theme, window and shortcut settings.
Toolbox › Desktop: Clipboard Slots — 9 saved clipboard slots (Clipboard history: Win+V).
Toolbox › Desktop: Desktop Widgets — CPU/RAM/battery pill on the panel; add more: right-click panel > Add New Items.
Toolbox › Desktop: Gesture Settings — 3-finger swipes and pinch (touchpad settings).
Toolbox › Files: File Recovery — Trash first, then deep recovery with PhotoRec.
Toolbox › Files: Batch File Converter — Converts every picture/song/video in a folder.
Toolbox › Files: File Permissions — See who may read/change/run a file; set a mode like 644 or 755.
Toolbox › PDF & Media: Join Videos (Recording Editor) — Joins screen recordings/clips without re-encoding.
Toolbox › PDF & Media: Media Library — How many pictures, songs, videos and documents you have.
Toolbox › PDF & Media: Screen Annotation — Draw on the screen (presentations, teaching).
Toolbox › PDF & Media: Screenshot Editor — Select an area, then edit the picture.
Toolbox › Laptop: Battery History — Battery level over time and how fast it drains.
Toolbox › Laptop: USB Health Check — USB devices and connection errors this start-up.
Toolbox › Laptop: Audio Devices — Speakers, headphones and microphones that were found.
Toolbox › Laptop: Display Information — Screens, resolution and graphics driver.
Toolbox › Laptop: Hardware Assistant — Detects hardware and applies the right fixes.
Toolbox › Productivity: Notes & Notes Sync — New note, or sync Documents/Notes with a USB/folder.
Toolbox › Productivity: Workspace Saver — Save the open apps; restore them later (also after restart).
Toolbox › Productivity: Custom Hotkeys — Create your own keyboard shortcuts.
Toolbox › Network: Wi-Fi Signal History — Signal strength over time.
Toolbox › Network: Wi-Fi Auto Reconnect — Saved networks reconnect by themselves, forever.
Toolbox › Network: Network Devices — Phones, PCs and printers on your Wi-Fi.
Toolbox › Network: Download Resume Manager — Downloads that continue after a broken connection.
Toolbox › Network: Connection Priority — Which saved network is used first (higher = first).
Toolbox › Network: Local File Sharing — Send files to a phone/PC on the same Wi-Fi.
Toolbox › Security: USB Security Scanner — Finds autorun files, hidden and disguised programs on a USB drive.
Toolbox › Security: Login Attempt Alerts — Wrong password attempts (also notified at login).
Toolbox › Security: App Integrity Checker — Checks every program file against its package.
Toolbox › Security: Permission Change History — Notices when private folders become readable by others.
Toolbox › Security: Guest Account — A guest login without admin rights.
Toolbox › Security: Automatic Screen Lock — Lock after some idle minutes and on sleep.
Toolbox › Security: Suspicious Startup Check — Start-up entries from temp/hidden folders or unknown programs.
Toolbox › Security: Firewall Dashboard — Firewall state and blocked connection attempts.
Toolbox › Security: Security Audit — A score with what to fix.
Toolbox › Security: Encrypted Vault — AES-256 encrypted private folder.
Toolbox › System: RAM & CPU History — Memory and processor load over time.
Toolbox › System: Background App Analyzer — Programs running without a window.
Toolbox › System: Low-RAM Emergency — Closes the biggest apps when memory is almost full.
Toolbox › System: Smart ZRAM Controller — Compressed memory: auto by RAM, or choose a profile.
Toolbox › System: Cache Cleaner — Old cache (weekly by itself) or everything.
Toolbox › System: Process Priority — Give a program more or less CPU time.
Toolbox › System: Driver Status — Every device and the driver it uses.
Toolbox › System: Repository Manager — Where apps and updates come from.
Toolbox › System: Package Dependency Checker — What a package needs and what needs it.
Toolbox › System: Boot Menu Settings — Boot menu time and logo/text start-up (installed NAVIN).
Toolbox › System: Restore Points — System snapshots and rollback.
Toolbox › NAVIN: App Compatibility Checker — Will this .exe/.deb/AppImage run on NAVIN?
Toolbox › NAVIN: Smart Maintenance Center — Checks disk, services, updates and cache; fixes on request.
Toolbox › NAVIN: System Benchmark — Repeatable speed test.
Toolbox › NAVIN: Welcome Center — First steps and What's New.
Toolbox › NAVIN: Control Hub — Quick toggles and settings.
Toolbox › NAVIN: Theme Studio — Light/dark/auto theme.
Toolbox › NAVIN: Update Dashboard — NAVIN updates and history.
Toolbox › NAVIN: Recovery Assistant — Repairs, boot repair and recovery.
Toolbox › Desktop: Account Picture — Your picture on the login and lock screen.
Toolbox › Network: Internet Speed Test — Real download speed and response time.
Toolbox › Network: Network Reset — Restart Wi-Fi/cable networking (passwords kept).
Toolbox › Security: Parental Controls — Block websites for every user (example: youtube.com, games.com).
Toolbox › Productivity: Backup Schedule & Automation — Run a backup or your own command at a set time. Time: daily, weekly, *-*-* 20:00, Mon 09:00
Every feature named in the 1,100-feature request is matched to a real app, tool, shortcut or setting (checked by tests)
Honest notes for the few features XFCE cannot do fully (hibernate, jump lists, animated wallpapers ...)
Battery, RAM, CPU and Wi-Fi history: one tiny sample every 5 minutes, no background program
History timers switched on for every user
Automatic cache management once a week (thumbnails and app caches unused for 30 days)
Notification at login when someone typed a wrong password
Win+L really locks the screen now (light-locker); the Live user is never locked out
Wi-Fi login pages (hotels, stations) are detected
Internet Troubleshooter opens the Wi-Fi login page when one is needed
PDF reader (Atril), 7z/RAR archives, PhotoRec file recovery, screen drawing, screen reader (Orca)
Offline voice search and screenshot editor packages (installed when Debian has them)
Toolbox sidebar grouped: Desktop, Files, PDF & Media, Laptop, Network, Security, System, Productivity, NAVIN
Boot menu and system now say NAVIN 2.2 (all 2.1 touchpad and two-choice boot fixes kept)
